rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=32, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=0.00021567, epochs=3, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1050, seed=42, rationale=iter-8 (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). ONE KNOB (ARCHITECTURE): unet_c 24 -> 32 (MORE denoiser capacity), epochs traded DOWN 5 -> 3 to fund the bigger net inside the HARD 20-min wall. All else = iter-7 exactly (itnet_k=2, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=2.16e-4, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) iter-5 (c24/ep3): 0.8269. iter-6 (c24/ep4): 0.8385. iter-7 (c24/ep5): 0.8469=NEW BEST, SSIM 0.9983, PSNR 52.63, params 8.32M, elapsed 939.5s=15.7min. (2) SIGNAL: c=24 epochs lever still climbing (ep3->4 +0.0116, ep4->5 +0.0084) but iter-7 used 15.7/20min -> ~1 more epoch fits at c=24. Capacity (c16->c24) has been the dominant productive axis. Test whether MORE capacity (c=32) raises the ceiling further. (3) ONE KNOB: unet_c 24->32 (params 8.32M->~14.7M, UNet conv FLOPs x1.78 vs c24). epochs 5->3 funds it; k/train_n held. (4) HYPOTHESIS: c=32 even at 3 epochs lands within noise of or above c24/ep5=0.8469, signalling headroom to train it further. FALSIFIER: if hr < ~0.835 at c32/ep3 (below c24/ep4=0.8385), the bigger net is too under-trained within the wall -> iter-9 reverts to c24/ep5 champion and pivots to lr/alpha. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): iter-7 per-epoch@c24 ~=162s. c32 UNet share x1.78, projector flat -> per-epoch@c32 ~=200s, fixed ~140s. ep3: 140+3*200=740s=12.3min<1200s. max_train_s=1050 fences TRAIN phase. train_n=2400 (OOM-safe; FBP precompute flat in c; ~14.7M params fine on 24GB). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate iter-8 obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-9.
